title: Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam highlighting the divine power and grace of the Goddess
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi has shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam praising the divine power and infinite valour of the Goddess. The verse describes her as the supreme source of the universe and conveys that, when pleased, she becomes the means to liberation for all beings on Earth. The Prime Minister wrote on X; “त्वं वैष्णवी शक्तिरनन्तवीर्या विश्वस्य बीजं परमासि माया। सम्मोहितं देवि समस्तमेतत् त्वं वै प्रसन्ना भुवि मुक्तिहेतुः।।”
त्वं वैष्णवी शक्तिरनन्तवीर्या विश्वस्य बीजं परमासि माया।

सम्मोहितं देवि समस्तमेतत् त्वं वै प्रसन्ना भुवि मुक्तिहेतुः।। https://t.co/ydpq4tfZRL — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) October 13, 2026
